description: This walk explores how artists, activists and local communities have contested, defended and reimagined urban space across Wanstead Flats and Leytonstone. From the struggle to protect common land and Epping Forest to the creative resistance of the M11 protests and contemporary grassroots projects, we uncover histories of collective action, cultural imagination and alternative visions for the city.

factsheet.heading: About the walk
paragraphs: This walk traces a stretch of east London where common land, streets and public space have been repeatedly contested, where every act of enclosure met an act of imagination. Starting at Wanstead Station and ending at Leyton Underground Station, it moves through the forest edge, buried rivers, lost streets and places where people tried to imagine the city otherwise: the M11 link road campaign, the Free State of Wanstonia, the 1871 battle for Epping Forest, squat galleries, artist tenancies and the 1994 eviction of Claremont Road. Part of what we’re looking at is still visible; much of it has gone. The walk is partly about learning to read absence and forgotten futures.

factsheet.heading: Clothing and Footwear Requirement
paragraphs: The walk covers 2.6 miles over approximately 2.5 hours. The route includes open grassland on Wanstead Flats which can be uneven and waterlogged in wet weather. Sturdy, weatherproof footwear is strongly recommended. The walk takes place outdoors with no indoor shelter until the final section. Participants should dress for the weather.

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs: The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.  Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
